title: A registration body needs a name and a valid email
statement: The body MUST be `{ "name": string, "email": string }`. The name is trimmed and MUST NOT be blank; the email is trimmed and MUST look like an address (`x@y.z`, no spaces). Otherwise the response MUST be 400 `invalid_request`.

title: A registered email is refused with 409 email_taken
statement: When a member with the same email, ignoring case and surrounding spaces, is already registered, the response MUST be 409 `email_taken`.

title: A registration returns 201 with the new member
statement: A successful registration MUST return 201 with the member: `id` (a whole number), `name` (trimmed), `email` (trimmed, lower case) and `joinedAt` (an ISO 8601 time).

title: A tool body needs a name
statement: The body MUST be `{ "name": string, "description"?: string }`. The name is trimmed and MUST NOT be blank, or the response MUST be 400 `invalid_request`. A missing description is stored as an empty string.

title: Adding a tool returns 201 with an available catalog entry
statement: A successful add MUST return 201 with the catalog entry: `id`, `name`, `description`, `condition` (`good`), `damageNote` (null), `addedAt` and `status` (`available`).

title: The catalog lists every tool with its status
statement: The response MUST be 200 with an array of every catalog entry in ID order. Each entry MUST carry `condition`, `damageNote` and `status`: `on_loan` when the tool has an active loan, otherwise `needs_repair` when its condition is `needs_repair`, otherwise `available`.

title: A borrow names a member and a tool that exist
statement: The body MUST be `{ "memberId": number, "toolId": number }`, each a positive whole number; otherwise the response MUST be 400 `invalid_request`. When no member has that ID the response MUST be 404 `member_not_found`; when no tool has that ID, 404 `tool_not_found`.

title: A member who cannot borrow is refused with 409 and the reason
statement: When the member has an overdue loan the response MUST be 409 `member_overdue`. When the member already holds 3 active loans it MUST be 409 `loan_limit_reached`.

title: An unavailable tool is refused with 409 and the reason
statement: When the tool needs repair the response MUST be 409 `tool_needs_repair`. When the tool is on loan it MUST be 409 `tool_on_loan`.

title: The first failing check is the one reported
statement: When several checks fail, the response MUST report only the first, in this order: invalid body, unknown member, unknown tool, member overdue, loan limit reached, tool needs repair, tool on loan.

title: A borrow returns 201 with the loan and its due date
statement: A successful borrow MUST return 201 with the loan: `id`, `memberId`, `toolId`, `borrowedAt` (an ISO 8601 time), `dueDate` (a date, YYYY-MM-DD, in the library's time zone) and `returnedAt` (null). It MUST NOT carry a due time.

title: A return body needs a condition of good or needs_repair
statement: The body MUST be `{ "condition": "good" | "needs_repair", "note"?: string }`. A missing or other condition MUST give 400 `invalid_condition`. A blank note is stored as none.

title: An unknown or already returned loan is refused
statement: When no loan has that ID the response MUST be 404 `loan_not_found`. When the loan was already returned it MUST be 409 `already_returned`, and the loan MUST NOT change.

title: A return returns 200 with the loan and whether it was late
statement: A successful return MUST return 200 with the loan, including `dueDate`, `returnedAt`, `returnCondition`, `returnNote` and `late`: true when returned on a day after the due date in the library's time zone, otherwise false.

title: A damage report needs a note and a tool that exists
statement: The body MUST be `{ "note": string }` with a note that is not blank, or the response MUST be 400 `invalid_request`. When no tool has that ID the response MUST be 404 `tool_not_found`.

title: A damage report returns 200 with the tool needing repair
statement: A successful report MUST return 200 with the catalog entry: `condition` `needs_repair` and `damageNote` the trimmed note. Its `status` stays `on_loan` while the tool is lent, since the loan carries on.

title: A damage report over 64 KB is refused with 413
statement: A request body over 64 KB MUST be refused with 413 `body_too_large` before it is parsed, so a long or endless note cannot use up the server's memory. The note is the API's only free text that can grow without bound; the same limit applies to every endpoint's body.

title: A damage report on a tool that already needs repair is refused with 409
statement: When the tool already needs repair the response MUST be 409 `tool_already_damaged`, and the tool MUST keep its first damage note (TL-LEND-INV02).

title: Only a tool that exists and needs repair can be marked repaired
statement: When no tool has that ID the response MUST be 404 `tool_not_found`. When the tool is in good condition it MUST be 409 `tool_not_damaged`.

title: Marking a tool repaired returns 200 with it available
statement: A successful repair MUST return 200 with the catalog entry: `condition` `good`, `damageNote` null and, unless the tool is on loan, `status` `available`.
